apps.name: JellyMuse
apps.localizedDescription: Jellyfin Music Client that mimics Apple Music

versions.localizedDescription:
Lyrics rebuilt for smoother scrolling and line changes, plus faster song start-up.

• New lyrics engine, now the default for both plain and word-synced lyrics
• Karaoke wipe, duets, background vocals, intro/interlude dots and stepped blur, matching Apple Music
• Lines hand over as the previous one ends, so quick lines get their full wipe; the wipe's soft edge now spills slightly into the next word, and lines ease back to idle
• Pronunciation under each word (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) and translations under each line, including for background vocals
• Arabic and Hebrew lyrics drawn right to left, with a left-to-right pronunciation row
• Korean words stay together when a line wraps
• Tap highlight now fits each line with its translation and pronunciation
• Songs start faster: the audio session, the server connection and the Atmos check are now prepared in parallel the moment you tap a song, and the next song no longer competes with the one you're hearing
• Fixes: wipe after seeking back, last lines staying lit to the end of a song, early-lit pronunciation letters, long-note swell on mixed-language lines, translations jumping in size, pronunciation ghosting on background vocals, and tapping to show the controls no longer jumps to a lyric
